status: nominal CAD-to-link calibration; verify against hardware before sim2real
intrinsics_source: configurable benchmark pinhole defaults; not measured D405 intrinsics

mount_geometry_notes.convention: USD row vectors, meters, one xformOp:transform; ordered parent deltas multiply on right; local deltas on left. CAD scale lives on child.
mount_geometry_notes.left: Upper-face selection uses measured ee_left world pose: local -Y is up in raised-arm reference pose. CAD tab seats on independently extracted left flat Y=-24.9999706 mm. Existing axial station/contact retained; mechanical half-turn removed and image roll compensated.
mount_geometry_notes.head: CAD bottom Y=0; four mounting holes X=-16/+10, Z=+/-18 mm match head top holes X=+/-13, Y=-18.34/+17.66 mm at Z=45 mm after delta. Pivot is hole-pattern center (-3,0,0) mm.
mount_geometry_notes.head_d405: Translation-only least-squares registration: D405 rear holes (X=+/-10,Y=0,Z=-23) mm to bracket inner flange holes (X=21,Y=12,Z=+/-10) mm. Both pairs spaced 20 mm. Existing housing and optical orientations retained.
mount_geometry_notes.optical: CAD width +Y, forward +Z; keep CAD-to-OpenGL basis. Left image roll compensates new 180 degree mechanical rotation; right retains 180 degrees.
mount_geometry_notes.right: Contact tab CAD Y=-39 mm maps to independently extracted right body flat Y=-25 mm; X retained; Z shifted minimally onto the flat patch below its curved rim. Body mesh omits fastening holes.
